question: What is the primary method of delivering care in tele-nursing?
explanation: Tele-nursing relies fundamentally on digital communication tools to connect nurses with patients remotely. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h1)

question: Why is tele-nursing particularly useful for remote populations in Nigeria?

options.A: It bridges geographical gaps in healthcare access
options.B: It provides free medication to all citizens
options.C: It eliminates the need for any hospital buildings
options.D: It completely replaces doctors in rural clinics

explanation: Virtual care delivery allows patients in distant or underserved areas to receive nursing guidance without traveling far. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h1)

question: Which tele-nursing model involves sending recorded health data for later review?
explanation: The store-and-forward method captures information like test results and forwards them asynchronously to a clinician. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h2)

question: A wearable device tracking a patient's blood pressure daily represents which model?
explanation: Continuous tracking of physiological metrics using devices falls under remote patient monitoring. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h2)

question: Which software system is essential for storing patient records in digital practice?
explanation: Electronic health records manage and store patient medical histories securely in a digital format. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h3)

question: What is a major infrastructure challenge for tele-nursing in Nigeria?

options.B: Too many digital stethoscopes in rural pharmacies
options.C: Erratic power supply and poor network bandwidth
options.D: An excess of high-speed fiber optic cables

explanation: Unstable electricity and weak internet signals disrupt continuous virtual communication and data transmission. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h3)

question: Who regulates the nursing profession and sets practice standards in Nigeria?

options.C: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria

explanation: The Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria is the statutory body governing nursing education and practice standards. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h4)

question: Why is data encryption critical in tele-nursing platforms?

options.B: To speed up video streaming quality
options.C: To reduce the cost of mobile data
options.D: To maintain patient confidentiality and privacy

explanation: Encryption protects sensitive health information from unauthorized access during digital transmission. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h4)

question: What skill becomes especially vital during a virtual patient assessment?
explanation: Without physical touch, nurses must depend on visual cues and verbal communication to assess the patient. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h5)

question: A nurse guiding a caregiver on camera to check skin turgor demonstrates what?
explanation: Guiding a proxy to perform simple checks on camera helps bridge the gap caused by physical absence. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h5)

question: Which health condition is most suitable for ongoing tele-nursing monitoring?
explanation: Chronic illnesses requiring daily self-management and regular tracking are ideal for tele-nursing oversight. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h6)

question: How does tele-nursing help reduce emergency hospital visits for chronic patients?

options.B: By catching small health deviations early
options.C: By curing the underlying genetic defect

explanation: Early detection of worsening symptoms allows timely intervention before the condition becomes an emergency. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h6)

question: Which factor is NOT a common barrier to tele-nursing adoption in resource-limited settings?

options.A: Excessive availability of free high-speed broadband
options.B: Limited digital literacy among elderly patients
options.C: High costs associated with mobile internet data

explanation: High-speed broadband is rarely free or excessively available in resource-limited settings; lack of access is the actual barrier. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h7)

question: How can community-based digital hubs help overcome tele-nursing barriers?

options.A: By providing trained intermediaries to assist patients with technology
options.B: By eliminating the need for professional nurses
options.C: By converting every patient home into a mini hospital
options.D: By banning the use of traditional medicine entirely

explanation: Digital hubs with knowledgeable assistants help bridge the technology gap for patients who struggle with devices. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h7)

question: What skill set must modern nurses develop alongside traditional clinical acumen?
explanation: Modern nursing practice requires comfort with digital tools and health informatics to manage virtual patient care. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h8)

question: Why are nursing schools updating their curricula to include health informatics?

options.A: To ensure students never have to touch a patient again
options.B: To replace clinical placements with computer games
options.C: To focus exclusively on hospital administration
options.D: To prepare graduates for technology-driven healthcare environments

explanation: Informatics education equips future nurses to handle emerging digital health tools effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T10#GNS113_U1_T10_h8)
